title: Parasailing en Fort Lauderdale
specs: Snorkel in a protected natural marine area with abundant marine life
Catamaran tour includes whale watching and swimming stop
Astronomical tour includes visit to Teide Observatory and star observation with telescope
Quad tour reaches up to 2,000 meters altitude and visits volcanic landscapes
Teide excursion includes walking around the base of the volcano and optional teleférico ride
For quad tour: minimum age 25 years, 2 years driving license validity, max weight 160 kg, no pregnant women
Children 7-18 years can ride as passengers on double quads
No children under 3 years, pregnant women or people with cardiovascular problems can use Teide teleférico
